title.narrative: Diplomado en restauracin del Bosque de Niebla: diseminando la semilla de la capacitacin en Mxico a su convocatoria de vida silvestre sin fronteras 2014.

description.narrative: Mesophilic cloud forests in Mexico are being lost at an alarming rate despite its importance as biodiversity and water reservoirs. In response to this challenge, Pronatura Mexico A.C developed a certificate course on cloud forest restoration as a tool to strengthen the capacities of decision makers, field technicians, natural resources administrators, conservation leaders, community leaders, and land owners from all over Mexico. Through this grant, the Recipient will: 1) update and improve the quality of the virtual training learning tools (5 new video clips will be produced and uploaded in the training platform); 2) produce an electronic training manual; 3) deliver the 4th edition of the Mesophilic Cloud Forest Restoration Techniques certificate, a 5 month on-line and field based course for at least 35 participants; 4) provide technical support and guidance to course participants in the implementation of several on-the-ground cloud forest conservation projects in different regions of Mexico; and 5) create an on-line network of cloud forest restoration practitioners as knowledge, information and experiences exchange tool.
